source.title: Elliptic Curves for Security: X25519's Diffie-Hellman vector

requirements.quote: The functions take a scalar and a u-coordinate as inputs and produce a u-coordinate as output.
Both now share K = X25519(a, X25519(b, 9)) = X25519(b, X25519(a, 9)) as a shared secret.

exclusions.quote: When receiving such an array, implementations of X25519 (but not X448) MUST mask the most significant bit in the final byte.
exclusions.reason: this fixture checks the Section 6.1 vector only; amritk/nish's specs/rfc7748-x25519.md tests the mask

exclusions.quote: Implementations MUST accept non-canonical values and process them as if they had been reduced modulo the field prime.
exclusions.reason: this fixture checks the Section 6.1 vector only; amritk/nish's specs/rfc7748-x25519.md tests non-canonical values

exclusions.quote: For X25519, the unused, most significant bit MUST be zero.
exclusions.reason: this fixture checks the Section 6.1 vector only; amritk/nish's specs/rfc7748-x25519.md tests the output's top bit

exclusions.quote: The cswap function SHOULD be implemented in constant time (i.e., independent of the swap argument).
exclusions.reason: timing is not observable by a functional test

exclusions.quote: The trace of Frobenius MUST NOT be in {0, 1} in order to rule out the attacks described in [smart], [satoh], and [semaev], as in [brainpool] and [safecurves].
exclusions.reason: an obligation on choosing a curve, which Curve25519 already meets; nothing an implementation of X25519 does can satisfy or violate it

exclusions.quote: MOV Degree [reducing]: the embedding degree MUST be greater than (order - 1) / 100, as in [brainpool] and [safecurves].
exclusions.reason: an obligation on choosing a curve, which Curve25519 already meets; nothing an implementation of X25519 does can satisfy or violate it

exclusions.quote: CM Discriminant: discriminant D MUST be greater than 2^100, as in [safecurves].
exclusions.reason: an obligation on choosing a curve, which Curve25519 already meets; nothing an implementation of X25519 does can satisfy or violate it
